summary: Re-review after T7r2 (c9f6bba1 + e8312fc1). The new listener-owner verification has no path or process handling gap: fixed-argv ss parsing of the constant port, /proc/<digits>/stat reads only with EPERM fail-open that can never classify a foreign listener as owned, a desync-safe stat parse, and assertOwned at three evidence boundaries where every failure mode fails closed. Input causality (page-side event counting plus a committed false-pass pin) and the negative control work. All r2 properties re-verified at this HEAD: full run green (moves=3, negative_control.changed=false, check.json scrubbed), 277 ms collision failure with a decoy in one heavy-run call, --game handling unchanged, signals to the parent free the port within ~2 s with no orphans. No findings.
evidence: New listener-owner code is safe: listeningPids() uses execFileSync('ss', ['-ltnp']) with fixed argv (no shell, no injection; the port is a constant) and extracts pid=(\d+) only from lines containing 127.0.0.1:5199 and LISTEN; childTree() reads only /proc/<digits>/stat (names filtered ^\d+$, no path traversal) and treats other users' EPERM entries as absent, so a foreign listener can never be classified owned; the stat parse anchors on the last ')' so command names with spaces cannot desync the ppid; assertOwned runs at three boundaries (lines 236, 422, 431) and every failure mode fails closed (owner mismatch throw or 60 s timeout, never a pass).

Input causality: the init script counts page-side keydown/pointerdown events and acceptedAction requires eventsAfter > eventsBefore (lines 409-419), so a harness-only state write cannot count as a move; the committed pin e8312fc1 asserts acceptedAction(before, after, false) === false; the negative control (1500 ms quiet window) must show no change and throws otherwise (lines 387-391).

Full run green (probe-p3-r2-full.mjs): exit 0, started=true, moves=3 (action_inputs ['ArrowRight','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight']), negative_control.changed=false, state_changed=true, errors=0, all four built-ins absent in page, port free at parent exit (~0 ms), check.json grep-clean of '/home/' and the user name.

Collision (probe-p3-r2-collision.mjs): decoy on 127.0.0.1:5199 inside one heavy-run call; failed in 277 ms with scrubbed 'port 5199 already in use', no spawn, no orphan, port free, check.json and output grep-clean.
--game handling (probe-p3-r2-args.mjs): bad value, missing value, no arguments, injection attempt, unknown game, unknown flag all exit 1 with usage; --help exits 0; no injection file created.
Signals (probe-p3-signal.mjs, PID-set diffing): SIGTERM and SIGINT to the Node parent only; each vite child freed the port within ~2 s, no chromium orphan, no baseline process harmed, both exit 1.

PM load rule: every decoy, signal, and full run went through heavy-run.sh with HEAVY_MIN_AVAIL_MB=1500; the only 5199 listener at audit end belongs to another session's check run (parent PID verified); nothing of mine remains and nothing needed killing.
A2 not applicable: no draft-to-published path. A6: doc comment fields (negative_control, action_inputs semantics) match the observed check.json output.
